summary.value: Junior's Times Square is the Midtown outpost of the Brooklyn cheesecake landmark, at 1515 Broadway at 45th Street in the middle of the Theater District, serving diner classics in big portions. Restaurantji diners praise Great service, great food, big meals and the cheesecakes! and call it Such a fun atmosphere!. Expect a wait at busy times, which guests say is worth it.

description.value: Junior's Times Square is the Midtown branch of the Brooklyn cheesecake landmark. It is at 1515 Broadway @ 45th Street, in the middle of the Theater District. Posted hours include Sunday – Monday 7am - 11pm, so it works for a late slice after a show. Restaurantji shows 4.3 1727 ratings. Representative Restaurantji praise (diner reviews): “Great service, great food, big meals and the cheesecakes!”. Representative watch-outs: “The weight was a little long but it is absolutely worth it”. A Restaurantji reviewer also liked the Friendly staff and dang good coffee!

itineraryNote: Junior's Times Square: a big, cheerful Theater District diner; finish a show night with a slice of cheesecake.
review1: Cheesecake is the reason most diners visit Junior's, alongside big portions and generally good service for a Times Square meal.
review2: The atmosphere is lively and family-friendly, with an amazing lunch, delicious desserts and a fun, busy room that makes it a cheerful stop for groups and children alike.
review3: It also works for a quick stop, with friendly staff and really good coffee alongside the desserts, so a short pastry-and-coffee break is easy even when the room is busy.
review4: Lines are common at busy times, but diners say the wait is worth it, so allow extra time around showtimes.
